audit_warns: 32 GB (2x16) DDR4-2666 UDIMM is rated 2666 MT/s; ASRock H110 Pro BTC+ 13-GPU mining board runs memory at 2400 MT/s — it will train down, so the bandwidth figure should use 2400, not 2666
ASRock H110 Pro BTC+ 13-GPU mining board runs its extra slots at PCIe 2.0 x1 (~500 MB/s each). Fine for kernel dispatch and mining; it will starve any workload that streams tensors host->device
